channel.title: IOWarp news and releases
channel.description: Releases, papers, and milestones from the IOWarp team at the Gnosis Research Center, each with its source.

item.title: IOWarp soft launches at SC26 in Chicago
item.description:
IOWarp and the CLIO platform soft launch at SC26 in Chicago. The team presents work on simulation monitoring, GPU I/O, storage observability, compressed training data, and agent fleets through workshop presentations, research posters, a conference paper, and an HDF5 birds-of-a-feather session. Workshop presentations take place on November 16, research posters on November 17, Trigger, Render, Reason on November 18, and the HDF5 birds-of-a-feather session on November 19. The community page lists every title, time, room, and program entry.

15–20 NOV 2026 · SC26 conference site

item.title: CLIO Coder releases approved extensions and playbooks
item.description:
The stable coding agent separates content plugins from sandboxed extensions that load after capability approval. Playbooks describe fleet contracts, and an optional semantic context index searches code, approved memory, and evidence. Background indexing is off by default.

9 OCT 2026 · CLIO Coder release notes

item.title: CLIO Core fixes wheel startup and adds a documentation site
item.description:
Published wheels now include the indexer required by the default filesystem chain, fixing the earlier mount and runtime-start failures. The Core documentation site covers installation, Python APIs, storage composition, data operators, and the runtime dashboard. Agent retains its own tested dependencies.

9 OCT 2026 · CLIO Core release notes

item.title: CLIO Kit adds selective components and workflow plugins
item.description:
The published Kit release brings scientific MCP servers, skills, agents, hooks, and workflow plugins into a meta-marketplace. Its small launcher downloads selected components, keeps server dependencies isolated and locked, and installs supported workflows into client projects. The release is available on GitHub and PyPI, with its server contracts published to the MCP Registry.

08 OCT 2026 · CLIO Kit release record

item.title: CLIO Coder documents context continuity
item.description:
The CLIO Coder guides include a context continuity guide that separates working context, handoffs, and durable memory. The latest release, published to npm as @iowarp/clio-coder, keeps it current.

27 SEP 2026 · CLIO Coder releases

item.title: wtf-MS reaches a stable release
item.description:
The University of Utah’s materials research-planning workflow reached its first stable release. Its CLIO Coder port, Materio, shipped earlier in September.

22 SEP 2026 · wtf-MS repository

item.title: IOWarp joins two DOE Genesis Mission projects
item.description:
In August 2026 the IOWarp team joined two DOE Genesis Mission projects: SPOTTER-AI at Argonne and PORTUS at PNNL. CLIO Agent supplies the investigating agents for SPOTTER-AI, and the IOWarp team works on workflow motifs and performance models in PORTUS.

AUG 2026 · DOE Genesis Mission

item.title: A coordinated CLIO release wave
item.description:
Releases across CLIO Core, Kit, Agent, CLIO Coder, and Relay between mid and late August, including the Spotter approval mode in CLIO Agent. Each repository’s release notes carry the details.

AUG 2026 · The repositories

item.title: Agents that watch simulations, at SC 2026
item.description:
Trigger, Render, Reason, accepted at SC 2026 and scheduled for presentation in Chicago on November 18, pairs science-aware triggers with multimodal model confirmation to stop spending compute on invalid simulation runs.

2026 · Publication record

item.title: New IOWarp papers at IEEE eScience 2026
item.description:
AgentStage uses an agent’s reasoning time to stage data; Acropolis brings AI-driven semantic search to HPC storage; a multi-institution paper defines I/O-centric derived quantity operators for in situ processing.

2026 · eScience 2026 program

item.title: CLIO Core takes the CLIO name
item.description:
A major CLIO Core release renamed the runtime and its engines under the CLIO name, including the Context Transfer Engine and the Context Assimilation Engine. The architecture has continued to evolve in later releases.

27 MAY 2026 · CLIO Core releases

item.title: CLIO Core on ALCF Aurora
item.description:
The Gnosis project record reports that the team ported CLIO Core to Aurora at the INCITE GPU hackathon and ran scientific workloads there. NERSC lists the event as April 28–30, 2026.

APR 2026 · Gnosis project record

item.title: IOWarp beta presented in Denver
item.description:
The team presented the integrated IOWarp beta to fellow research cyberinfrastructure teams in Denver.

28 JUL 2025 · Poster on figshare
